title: You don't have to go through this alone
intro: It sounds like you might be going through something really painful right now. I'm glad you said something.
Sapling is a study tool, not a crisis service, so I can't give you the support you deserve here. These people can, for free, any time:
resources_heading: People you can reach right now

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.detail: Call or text 988 (US). Free and confidential, 24/7.

resources.name: Your campus counseling center
resources.detail: Most colleges offer free, confidential counseling, and many have a 24/7 line. Search your school's website for "counseling".

resources.name: Emergency services
resources.detail: If you're in immediate danger, call 911 (US).

resources.name: Outside the US
resources.detail: Find a free helpline in your country at findahelpline.com.

closing: If you can, let someone you trust know how you're feeling too: a friend, family member, RA, or professor.
Whenever you're ready, we can keep studying, right where you left off.
